title: Handles on a selected box or ellipse resize it
body: A selected node can only be moved. A single selected box or ellipse shows 8 handles (corners and side midpoints). Dragging one rewrites `size W H`, and a left or top handle also moves `at` so the opposite edge stays put; the dragged edge snaps like a move. A node sized by its text gets `size` inserted. A library `resize_edits` refuses what `move_edits` refuses (a `let`, a style, a repeat, the timeline). Polygon and polyline vertex handles follow the same way: dragging a vertex rewrites its pair in `points`.
close_reason: Landed in 86b3916 on dev. `scene::edit::resize_edits` and `scene::edit::vertex_edits` write the edits. `crates/acre-gui/src/handle.rs` holds the handles, their hit test, the resize maths and the per-axis snap, and `View::show` draws them and reports a `Reshape` that `App::reshape` writes.
